summary: Frontend-only validation of the Atlas 'constellation' visual refonte (it56). All 6 requested acceptance criteria pass with 0 console JS errors. Niveau 2 renders twins as glowing stars (no robot images), each domain territory contains a decorative constellation (data-testid='constellation-<regionId>', 7 present) with filaments; inter-domain arcs are curved (SVG paths use quadratic 'Q' curves, e.g. 'M 626.6 61 Q 668.2 50.18 709.8 61'); hovering a twin-node reveals its twin-nom (opacity 0 -> 1). Semantic zoom works: level 2 stars -> level 4 shows 41 robot medallions with permanent App IDs -> zoom out restores level 1 corridors then level 2 stars, no visual artefacts. Regressions verified: arc click opens map-relation-detail, lasso (700,600)->(1050,350) shows multi-selection-bar with 7 twins, 'Parler à Flore' opens flore-panel, search 'Paiements' centers the map and opens panneau-jumeau. Ciel étoilé is fixed at pan (bounding rect left=56 before/after pan). Reorg mode: dragging twin 'paiements' in outil-edition mode moves it and the position persists across reload (delta < 1px). /travaux, /actualites, /jumeaux load with 0 console errors.
